findings.summary: the arm log that carries the done-when's local-placement result begins directly with its JSON array, so it names neither the revision it ran at nor the literal command, unlike timing-arm-live.log and timing-arm-local-room.log which carry both header lines; the done-when explicitly requires the timing arm's log to start with its revision and the literal command, and the manifest cites this file as evidence.

the arm named as delivering local placement substitutes snapshot._lane, which is the very input stating the local lane has room, and it also supplies its own ledger rows, verdict inputs and budget snapshot, so the done-when's local half is demonstrated on a substituted platform rather than the live one; the behaviour is separately guarded by tests/test_the_router_decides_on_preferences.py:297, which is why this does not hold the node.

the fragment asserts "All checks passed!" for the Ruff command but no Ruff log exists in the run directory and the manifest's test_logs names none, so the done-when's Ruff clause is claimed rather than recorded and the manifest's artifacts line is its only trace.
